nodes.label: 5-Brand Showcase Slider
nodes.rationale: Maximum 5 active brands displayed in horizontal carousel with arrow navigation. Order 1-5 determines vertical position on homepage. Text-based typography, no logo image uploads.

nodes.label: Curated Gender Slots (For Him / For Her / For Everyone)
nodes.rationale: Admin-selectable product slots per gender category. If a slot is left empty, the system auto-fills with the newest product. Four slots per gender group.
nodes.norm_label: curated gender slots (for him / for her / for everyone)

nodes.label: Tech Stack (Next.js 16, React 19, TailwindCSS v4, Drizzle, Zustand, S3, Sharp, Telegram, WhatsApp)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (next.js 16, react 19, tailwindcss v4, drizzle, zustand, s3, sharp, telegram, whatsapp)

nodes.label: app/actions/upload.ts (Clean Upload Pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Removing forceJpg preserves original format (PNG transparency, WebP). Removing Sharp watermark avoids server-side image mutation and crash on missing logo.

nodes.label: lib/compression.ts (Client-Side Canvas Compression)
nodes.rationale: Client-side compression solves HTTP 413 by reducing file size before server transmission (15MB to ~250KB). Preserves PNG transparency unlike the removed forceJpg approach.

nodes.label: S3 ACL Fallback Strategy
nodes.rationale: PutObjectCommand first tries with ACL: 'public-read'. If S3 provider rejects it (Bucket Owner Enforced), retries without ACL header. Handles IDCloudHost compatibility.

nodes.label: Client-Side Image Compression via Canvas
nodes.rationale: Browser-side HTML5 Canvas compression reduces files from ~15MB to ~250KB before Base64 encoding and server upload. Prevents HTTP 413 Payload Too Large errors.

nodes.label: Homepage Architecture & Sections
nodes.rationale: Homepage consists of: War/Flash Sale section, Popular & Sale tabs, Gender Split (For Him/Her/Everyone), and Brand Showcase Slider. Server-fetches 50 newest products in parallel.

nodes.label: Replace Sharp Watermark with CSS Overlay
nodes.rationale: Sharp watermark permanently mutates image pixels, causes blur, increases file size, and crashes if logo file is missing. CSS overlay is non-destructive, lightweight, and applied only in the browser.
nodes.norm_label: replace sharp watermark with css overlay

nodes.label: Admin Form Compression Integration Pattern
nodes.rationale: All admin forms with file inputs must follow compressImage -> fileToBase64 -> uploadImage pipeline. Applied to products, settings, banners, wars, testimonials pages.

nodes.label: CSS/HTML Watermark Overlay
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive UI watermark replaces server-side Sharp watermark. Text 'BEST PARFUME STORE' rendered via pure CSS with rotation, opacity 6%, pointer-events-none. Avoids image mutation and crash on missing logo.

nodes.label: S3 Orphaned File Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Previously, deleting products/banners only removed DB records, leaving physical files in S3. Now deleteProduct and deleteBanner call deleteFromS3 before DB deletion.

nodes.label: lib/s3-storage.ts (Resilient S3 Storage & Auto-Cleanup)
nodes.rationale: ACL fallback handles S3 providers with Bucket Owner Enforced policy. Auto-cleanup removes orphaned files when DB records are deleted.

nodes.label: Payment Proof Direct-to-Telegram Architecture
nodes.rationale: Payment proof images skip S3 storage entirely, sent directly to Telegram Bot admin chat. Keeps S3 bucket clean (Zero S3 Clutter). Order status updated to PAID.
